method: Direct visual inspection; no game launch. Full family/floor sheets are reviewed after completion.

intermediate.finding: Enclosed silver knight and centred vertical sword; readable at all three sizes.
Broad burning smith with two square hammers; distinct from champion and shipped demons.
Blue broad low spider with prominent yellow-white pattern; pale legs distinct from disc.
Uneven purple/green arms, visible stitches and broken weapon pieces; complete compact silhouette.
Pale bull with a compact square-headed greatmaul; distinct from axe minotaurs.
Ragged hood, large pale worm bundles and paired waraxes; no solid human arms.
Empty neck stump, distended belly and long bent arms; no head, face or eye escorts painted in.
Long slender raised neck and open horseshoe coil versus ice wyrm compact spiral and short broad head; storm drake is a crouched winged body. Distinct at 48/64/96, not just hue.
Low heavy wingless coil and densely layered blade armour, distinct from raised-neck winged storm wyrm.
Smooth slender high S-curve, small fins and swept horns; no wings, fading or afterimages.
Gold funerary armour, bright skull face, raised curved sword and ragged robe; no crown/rank graphic.
One gold wasp with a thin waist, four pale wings and a complete compact stinger/leg silhouette.

final_verdict: Eleven initial designs accepted by coordinator; storm-wyrm-v1 rejected for cold-family similarity and superseded by reviewed violet/gold storm-wyrm-v2. All twelve selected designs pass unchanged static gates. Live checks separate.

refinement_review.supersedes: storm-wyrm-v1; original intermediate and final storm conclusions superseded by coordinator review
refinement_review.outcome: recorded; strict style passed; visually accepted
refinement_review.finding: At 48/64/96px violet scales and yellow belly/lightning establish the shipped storm family. Broad gold-edged forked horns and scalloped fan wings differ from ice-wyrm needle crystals and Rantha pale angular fins. Upright neck and round coil distinguish the great wyrm from the crouching storm-drake. Gold belly keeps the body readable in grayscale and on all ten floor composites. Fine lightning lines become clearer at 64/96px.
